describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal hybrid that is mostly a brown bear in overall shape and covering, with glossy beetle parts integrated into its body. It stands in right-facing profile on four thick furry legs, covered in dense shaggy brown fur that is lighter tan on the muzzle and darker on the lower legs. The head, ears, torso, legs and paws are bear-like, while the back, neck, sides and rear bear shiny dark reddish-brown beetle elytra, translucent veined membranous wings protruding from the shoulder and chest, rows of narrow slit-like openings in the fur on the flank and hip, and a long segmented armored tail ending in two small points.

describe.description: A large stocky four-legged mammal covered in dense shaggy brown fur stands facing right. Its body, head, ears, legs and clawed paws are bear-like, but its rear ends in a glossy segmented dark insect-like tail with a forked tip, its shoulders, neck and side bear several glossy dark reddish-brown beetle-like shell cases, two large translucent veined insect wings project from its sides, and two rows of dark slit-like openings are visible in the fur on its flank.
